summary: Parses a config value string as an integer tuple of size 1-4. After key extraction by sub_565400, calls StrlenFormatCallWrapper with the value at this+0x180 and a parenthesized (%d,...) format chosen by which output pointers are non-null. Returns success only if the extraction count equals the expected tuple size. Non-null output pointers receive boolean (parsed_value != 0) results. Used by EngineSectionParser and TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

operations.description: If sub_565400(this, a2) returns 0 (key not found / no value extracted), return 0 immediately.

Call StrlenFormatCallWrapper with the value at this+0x180 and a format selected by non-null outputs: a6 -> "(%d,%d,%d,%d)" expecting 4; a5 -> "(%d,%d,%d)" expecting 3; a4 -> "(%d,%d)" expecting 2; only a3 -> "(%d)" then fallback "%d", both expecting 1.
If no output pointer is non-null, return 0 (no output targets).
Write boolean (parsed_value != 0) into each non-null output pointer.
Return whether the extraction count matched the expected tuple size (non-zero on success).
Format strings are the %d / (%d,...) data constants referenced from global storage.
Caller context: used by EngineSectionParser and TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

unresolved: Exact mapping of each global format constant to a specific (%d) variant.
sscanf-style overwrite of the output-pointer arguments aliases the parsed values to the passed pointers; exact pointer/value correspondence is derived, not confirmed.
Object identity behind this+0x180 value string.
